name: GSWP World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The promotion's top title, first decided by a single-elimination tournament, changing hands only once in this record when a returning ally's outside interference cost the champion his title at the promotion's own summer Pay-Per-View.

name: GSWP Television Championship
epitaph: The promotion's own "endurance belt," billed as defended nearly every week, changing hands twice across this record before settling on a champion who carried it through the rest of the promotion's surviving broadcasts.

name: GSWP Extreme Championship
epitaph: A weapons-based title created to settle a three-way grudge, its inaugural winner still carrying it at the promotion's own summer Pay-Per-View after turning back a hardcore challenger.
